name: MedGemma 1.5 4B
description: A fine-tuned multimodal open-weights variant of Google's Gemma 3/Gemma 3.5 architecture, optimized specifically for medical and healthcare AI applications. MedGemma 1.5 features advanced support for high-dimensional medical imaging analysis including 3D CT/MRI scans, histopathology Whole Slide Images (WSI), and EHR report generation.
keyFeatures: Fine-tuned specifically for healthcare domain terminology and reasoning
Support for high-dimensional medical imaging (CT scans, MRI scans, and longitudinal X-rays)
Anatomical localization and Whole Slide Image (WSI) parsing for histopathology
Generates structured medical reports from clinical image data
curatorNotes: Registered MedGemma 1.5 4B variant released on Jan 13, 2026. Highly capable open weights medical multimodal assistant.
